description: Defines a singleton class for caching and retrieving spatial reference system (SRS) information based on SRID and string ID, used within Apache Spark SQL internal types.

classes.name: SpatialReferenceSystemCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing mappings between SRID/CRS values and corresponding SRS information.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getSrsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SRS information based on SRID or string ID.
